Where intervention effort lives

Cost overview

10,020 relative points

Cost ranks interventions; it is not elapsed time. Higher scores mean a larger departure from an ordinary build. The build itself runs no intervention: every binary is plain source compiled and linked by Visual C++ 6.0. Image metadata is the link clock, set to its declared value before the comparison; Reference-byte quarantine identifies bytes of the original admitted into the comparison and is deliberately weighted heavily; its points do not represent a byte count.
